semantics.advanced-enumeration: 256 cap for initial candidate search; priest fallback uncapped if no Sanctum found
semantics.best-move: not claimed; no exhaustive P1 dominance or multi-turn minimax guarantee
semantics.classes: skill-then-soldier, soldier-then-skill, two-soldiers; up to four representatives per category
semantics.negative-result: no winning reply found is UNKNOWN rather than proof of safety
semantics.opponent: one complete Standard/Baseline Bot reply plus bounded Core-valid immediate-win counterexample search
semantics.privacy: no identifiers, network transmission or device data
semantics.same-root: all candidates replay from the same P0 GameState, not independently reconstructed diagrams
semantics.sampling: up to 3 basic skills + 3 advanced skills + 5 soldier first actions; up to 3-4 followups each; representative lowest-mana, max-capture, observed and advanced where available

source: P0 official-opening archived records; full receipt and superko replay verified before each comparison
